title.zh: 开放接合映射的保真与唯一共同因子
title.en: Question fidelity and unique factors of open joining maps

statement.en: A map of joinings that keeps the joining and lifts occurrences role by role is an open map of the role frames and keeps every branching test of roles; two such maps from one joining factor through the pairs alike in their roles, the factor keeping the joining and unique at every fragment.
statement.zh: 保持接合并逐角色提升发生的接合映射，是角色框架的开映射，并保持每个角色分支检验；自同一接合出发的两个这样的映射，经角色上相似的片段对分解，分解保持接合，且在每个片段处唯一。

laws.en: For any two frames, a map of configurations is open where its graph is a bisimulation; it is open exactly where it keeps the claims, carries every step to a step, and lifts every step from an image to a step onto it. Under an open map each configuration is alike to its image, and likeness is kept and reflected.
laws.zh: 对任两个框架：构型映射的图是互模拟时，映射是开的；映射开，恰当它保持断言、把每一步带到一步，并把从像出发的每一步提升为到它的一步。在开映射下，每个构型都与其像相似，相似被保持并被反映。

laws.en: Read through roles, a joining's fragments and occurrences of joining are places: a fragment enters an occurrence by a role it holds there, and an occurrence is left by a role to the fragment holding it; nothing else is claimed.
laws.zh: 经角色读取时，接合的片段与接合的发生都是位置：片段以它在某次发生中所持的角色进入该发生，发生以某角色离开到持该角色的片段；此外不作任何断言。

laws.en: For any two joinings, a map keeps the joining where fragments joined into one map to fragments joined into its image, and is an open map of joinings where it also lifts every occurrence holding the image of x in a role to one holding x in that role, mapped onto it role by role; exactly these maps keep the joining and read through roles as open maps of frames.
laws.zh: 对任两个接合：映射保持接合，是指结合成某片段的片段映到结合成其像的片段；它还把每个在某角色上持 x 之像的发生，提升为在该角色上持 x、逐角色映到它的发生时，是接合的开映射；恰是这些映射保持接合，且经角色读取是框架的开映射。

laws.en: Under any open map of joinings, every fragment is alike in its roles to its image and passes the same branching tests of roles, with no premise.
laws.zh: 在任一接合开映射下，每个片段在角色上与其像相似，并通过相同的角色分支检验，无需前提。

laws.en: For two open maps p and q from one joining L to joinings J and K, the map z ↦ (p z, q z) into the pairs of fragments alike in their roles, joined pair by pair, keeps L's joining and commutes with both maps, and every map into those pairs commuting with both agrees with it at every fragment; no finiteness and no decision is used.
laws.zh: 对自同一接合 L 到接合 J、K 的两个开映射 p、q：映射 z ↦ (p z, q z) 映入角色上相似的片段对（逐对结合），保持 L 的接合并与两映射相容；每个映入这些对、与两者相容的映射都在每个片段处与它一致；不用有限性，也不用判定。

laws.en: With extensionality of functions as a named hypothesis, for two open maps from one joining, every function into the pairs alike in their roles that commutes with both maps is their factor.
laws.zh: 以函数外延性为明示前提时，对自同一接合出发的两个开映射，每个映入角色上相似之对、与两映射相容的函数都就是它们的分解。

hypotheses.zh: 同一 L 的两映射 p:L→J、q:L→K 分别满足明示 OpenMap。
hypotheses.en: Two maps p:L→J and q:L→K from the same L satisfy the explicit OpenMap condition.
Uniqueness of the factor is stated at every fragment; as a function it takes extensionality of functions as a named hypothesis. No finiteness of the joinings is required.
hypotheses.zh: 分解的唯一性在每个片段处陈述；作为函数的唯一性取函数外延性为明示前提。不要求接合有限。

does_not_show.en: The factor keeps the joining and commutes with both maps; that it is open or onto is not shown.
does_not_show.zh: 分解保持接合并与两映射相容；它是开映射或满射未被表明。

does_not_show.en: No isomorphism of the whole and no unique provenance of a fragment follows from the factor.
does_not_show.zh: 由分解推不出整体的同构或片段的唯一来源。

next_delta.en: State when the factor of two open maps is itself open or onto, and derive the open-map condition for maps other than the projections of a common refinement.
next_delta.zh: 说明两个开映射的分解何时本身是开映射或满射，并为共同细化投影以外的映射推出开映射条件。

correspondence.zh: OpenMap 的强提升条件是给定解释条件；共同细化的投影无需前提即满足它（Joining.span_first_open、Joining.span_second_open）。
correspondence.en: The strong OpenMap lifting condition is supplied for a given interpretation; the projections of the common refinement satisfy it with no premise (Joining.span_first_open, Joining.span_second_open).

history.zh: 2026-10-14，整合 I3（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上重述。新的核心模块 Becoming.Joining（只导入 Becoming.Likeness）把片段的结合经伙伴、角色与保留引用读作脊柱的框架；描述提升一结合，恰当同一编码是伙伴框架的互模拟，无前提（Joining.lifts_iff）；Becoming.JoiningBridge 把结合研究读作实例。结合的开映射即角色框架的开映射（Joining.openMap_iff；桥接 openMap_iff_incidence），保持相同与每一角色检验（OpenMap.alike、Joining.OpenMap.sameBranchingTests、openMap_keeps_role_tests）；自一结合的两开映射经其分解，分解在每一片段处唯一（Joining.universal_factor）。与外围不同之处：唯一性逐点陈述，因函数相等需 funext；分解映入相同对，而非答案相同的对。外围的关联步、答案相同与跨度经带重叠通配分支的匹配定义（登记研究的步经 xs[i]?），其编译后的定义用到 propext，凡提及它们的陈述公理报告都不为空；所以此主张在核心的角色框架（Joining.roleFrame）或保留框架（Joining.retainedFrame）上重述，不是逐字实例；桥接表明外围的开映射与局部有限即核心的（openMap_iff_incidence、locallyFinite_iff）。外围的 every_exact_account_has_canonical_factor 需 funext 与 propext，留在外围。公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。
history.en: 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): restated on the spine. The new core module Becoming.Joining, importing only Becoming.Likeness, reads a joining of fragments as frames of the spine, through partners, roles and retained references; a description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the partner frame, with no premise (Joining.lifts_iff); Becoming.JoiningBridge reads the joining studies as instances. Open maps of joinings are the open maps of the role frames (Joining.openMap_iff; in the bridge openMap_iff_incidence) and keep likeness and every role test (OpenMap.alike, Joining.OpenMap.sameBranchingTests, openMap_keeps_role_tests); two open maps from one joining factor through it, the factor unique at every fragment (Joining.universal_factor). It differs from the periphery: uniqueness is pointwise, since equality of functions needs funext, and the factor maps into alike pairs rather than equally answering ones. The periphery's incidence step, sameness of answers and span are defined through a match with an overlapping wildcard case (the register study's step through xs[i]?), and their compiled definitions use propext, so no statement mentioning them has an empty axiom report; the claim is therefore restated on the core's role frame (Joining.roleFrame) or retained frame (Joining.retainedFrame), not as a literal instance, the bridge showing that the periphery's open maps and local finiteness are the core's (openMap_iff_incidence, locallyFinite_iff). The periphery's every_exact_account_has_canonical_factor needs funext and propext and stays there. Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing).
